name: adidas Yeezy Knit Runner 'Fade Indigo'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Knit Runner ‘Fade Indigo’ brings a gradient color scheme to the minimalist slip-on. Built with knit textile, the upper is rendered in an ombre effect made up of blue, green, and violet hues. A solid blue finish distinguishes the stretchy cuff that accentuates the sneaker’s snug, sock-like fit. Lightweight cushioning is provided by a hidden EVA misdsole. Underfoot, adidas branding decorates the brown rubber outsole, featuring a modified herringbone tread for superior grip.
